title: hYYa Footprint Inspector
shortDescription: Bona okwaziwa izinhlelo ngedivayisi, kulungise. Mahhala, kuvulekile, kuyimfihlo.
fullDescription:
Uhlelo ngalunye lokusebenza kudivayisi yakho lungafunda imininingwane ethule engahlanganiswa ukuze ikubone ukuthi ungubani. I-hYYa Footprint Inspector ikukhombisa ngqo lokho abangakubona, nokuthi ungakulungisa kanjani.

Yenza ukuhlolwa kobumfihlo ngemizuzwana embalwa: imininingwane yedivayisi efundwa yinoma yiluphi uhlelo ngaphandle kokubuza, lokho okunikezwa izimvume zezinhlelo zokusebenza ngempela, nokuthi yiziphi izinhlelo ezibucayi ezingatholwa. Okutholakele ngakunye kuza nencazelo ezolile nesixazululo, ngokuvamile ngokuthepha kanye ukuya ekhasini elifanele le-Settings.

Kungani kubalulekile: imininingwane efana negama ledivayisi yakho, ukuthi iqale nini kabusha okokugcina, ukuthi iqale kangaki, isikhala esisele ngokwe-byte, igama lama-earbuds akho, amakhibhodi kanye nezilimi zakho kubonakala kungenangozi uma kubhekwa ngakunye. Uma kuhlanganiswa, kusebenza njengesigxivizo sedivayisi (device fingerprint) esingakubona kuzo zonke izinhlelo zokusebenza futhi sakhe umkhondo wedijithali wokuthi ungubani.

LOKHO OKUTHOLAYO
• Isikolo somkhondo esizolile esiphuma ku-100 esibala kuphela lokho ongakushintsha.
• Yonke imininingwane ichaziwe: lokho okufundwa uhlelo, kungani isistimu ikuvumela, nokuthi kuhlala isikhathi esingakanani.
• Isixazululo salo lonke udaba: ukuthepha kanye ukuya ekhasini elifanele le-Settings, izinyathelo ezimbalwa ezilula, noma impendulo eqotho ethi "i-Google kuphela noma umenzi wedivayisi ongakulungisa lokhu".
• Ngaphambili nangemuva: skena futhi ubone ukuthi yini eshintshile.

UKWAZIWA NOMA NGABE USUSUSE UHLELO
I-Android inikeza izinhlelo zenkampani ngayinye ikhodi ehlala ifana noma ngabe uyazisusa uphinde uzifake kabusha. Bona eyakho, nokuthi kungani i-factory reset kuphela engayishintsha.

LOKHO IZINHLELO EZYIBONAYO UMA UVUMILE
Thepha imvume ukuze ubone ngqo ukuthi yini etholwa uhlelo kuyo: Indawo (Location), Amadivayisi aseduze (Nearby devices), Oxhumana nabo (Contacts) namakhalenda (Calendars). Uhlelo lubuza kuphela uma uthepha, futhi lubonisa amanani nezifinyezo, alukaze lubonise amagama abantu oxhumana nabo noma izihloko zemicimbi.

IZIPHI IZINHLELO EZIKUDIZAYO
Noma yiluphi uhlelo lungabheka ukuthi izinhlelo ezithile zifakiwe yini. Khetha izinhlobo zezinhlelo ofuna ukuzihlola (ezothando, ukholo, ezempilo, i-VPN, imiyalezo, i-crypto nokunye) bese ubona ukuthi yini engatholwa yinoma yiluphi uhlelo, kanye nezeluleko eziwusizo. Imiphumela ifihliwe uze uthephe, iyasulwa lapho uphuma, futhi ayigcinwa ndawo.

UKUHLOLWA KWEZIMVUME OKUHOLWAYO
I-Android ayilutsheli uhlelo ukuthi yiziphi ezinye izinhlelo ezingafinyelela endaweni yakho, koxhumana nabo noma kuzaziso. I-Settings kuphela eyaziyo. Lokhu kuhlola kukuhola kuyo yonke inqubo, kuhlanganise nokufinyelela kuzaziso, ukufinyelela ekusetshenzisweni, amasevisi okufinyeleleka (accessibility services), amakhibhodi kanye ne-ID yakho yokukhangisa, ngenkinobho eya ekhasini elifanele.

YENZELWE UBUMFIHLO NGOKUPHELELE
• Ayikho imvume ye-inthanethi: uhlelo alukwazi ukuxhuma ndawo, ngakho akukho lutho olushiya idivayisi yakho.
• Ayikho i-akhawunti, azikho izikhangiso, azikho izibalo zokusebenzisa, abekho abalandeleli (trackers).
• Kumahhala. Akukho ukuthenga ngaphakathi kohlelo, akukho okubhaliselwayo.
• I-open source ngaphansi kwe-Mozilla Public License 2.0.

Hlangana nomphenyi: uhlala kuwo wonke amakhasi futhi uneseluleko uma umthepha.

I-hYYa Footprint Inspector iyingxenye yomndeni wezinhlelo zokusebenza ze-hYYa ezibeka ubumfihlo phambili.
